summary: Dependency-confusion beacon exfiltrates host metadata to hardcoded VPS on install and require
details: The package is a stub whose only functional behavior is phoning home. package.json runs `node beacon.cjs` as a postinstall script, and index.js exports a no-op Proxy and invokes the same beacon on require(). beacon.cjs collects hostname, install path, cwd, process.cwd(), node version, and package coordinates and POSTs them as JSON to the hardcoded endpoint https://vmi3699893.contaboserver.net:8787/_ah/dc, with TLS verification disabled (rejectUnauthorized:false). The destination is a bare Contabo VPS unrelated to any declared publisher. The @c1-ease/bank scope name, stub implementation, and callback-only behavior match a dependency-confusion / typosquat probe designed to identify environments where an internal scoped name resolves to this public package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
